Name: More Wallpaper and Flooring At Pierre's
Author: cosmicRetribution
Description:
Obtaining the desired wallpaper and flooring for your house is almost impossible without use of the costly wallpaper catalogue. Of course, Pierre sells one (1) single piece of wallpaper and flooring per day. Yet, for example, there are over 120 wallpaper items in the game.

If you went to Pierre's every single day in search of a specific wallpaper, it could take you over a year in-game to be shown 120 wallpaper items, let alone 120 [i]different [/i]wallpaper items.

If you're someone who doesn't like waiting until you can afford all the catalogues just to decorate your house, then this mod is for you!

[size=4][i]More Wallpaper and Flooring [/i]simply adds a configurable number of randomly selected Wallpaper and Flooring items to Pierre's daily inventory. [/size]

The objective of this mod is simply to decrease reliance on the wallpaper catalogue and offer more daily choices. I thought that five of each (by default) seemed like a reasonable number to choose from, without over-filling Pierre's shop window with wallpaper and floors. However, you can now add up to 19 additional options (for a total of 20) if you would like more choices though, or add only one or two if you prefer.

It's also compatible with custom Wallpapers and Floorings from mods, too!

[size=1]It also adds a sort of Animal Crossing-like whimsy to the errand of visiting the shop and seeing what new items for your house are for sale today. :)[/size]

______

[color=#93c47d][size=3][b]7/2/2024 update:[/b][/size][/color] An update for my least used, most niche mod? Yep! Haven't had a lot of time for modding recently, but I noticed a minor bug in my own gameplay in year 2+ where the wallpapers would display in the middle of the new year 2 fertilizers, and it was bothering me. So, I decided to figure out a fix, and add a small new feature while I'm at it: [b]You can now enable or disable the ability to buy 'special' Wallpapers and Floorings [/b](ie. those normally only obtainable through exclusive catalogues, like the junimo catalogue) [b]at Pierre's. [/b]This is disabled by default for folks who like to keep things the way they are, but if you don't like waiting until you get ahold of that one darn catalogue to finish your room, there's now an option for that. :)

______

[size=3]Installation[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]This mod is for Stardew Valley 1.6[/size]
[*][size=2]Please make sure that you have the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher installed[/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]If you would like to configure the amount of Wallpapers/Floorings added, please make sure that you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ installed[/size][/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the file into your game's Mods folder, as per usual[/size]
[*][size=2]For Uninstallation: If you would like to revert to the default number of available wallpapers and floorings, simply delete "[CP] PierreMoreWallpaperFlooring" from your mods folder. [/size]
[/list]

[spoiler][size=2]Note that the randomly added wallpapers/floorings selected by this mod will be different from eachother (you will not see two of the same wallpaper selected in one day by [i]this mod[/i]), however it is possible that one of them may happen to draw the same wallpaper/flooring as the game's default one-a-day option in vanilla. This won't cause any problems, other than that on the off chance that should happen you will simply have slightly less choices that day.[/spoiler]

[/size][size=3]If you like this mod, you may also like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22079/]More Furniture At Robin's[/url] mod :) [/size]

[size=3]Happy Decorating![/size]

-Added an option to enable or disable "special" wallpapers and floorings.
